faq.answer: Bike accidents, ER visits, traffic stops, landlord disputes, immigration appointments… Whenever “office Thai” or English stops the conversation.

en.metaDescription: Health insurance Surin & Thailand: hospital cover, visa. Tammy (AXA) advises in French.
en.intro:
Private clinics often want payment upfront. Tammy advises in Surin on site and offers Thailand health insurance remotely: plans, visa, budget, in plain French. Former Phuket clients: Phuket Thailand health insurance.

KrungThai AXA · contact form / WhatsApp.

faq.question: Worth it if I’m healthy?
faq.answer: Care is excellent here; bills aren’t. Hospital + outpatient cover beats guessing after a scooter crash.

faq.question: Does my visa need a minimum policy?
faq.answer: Often yes (retirement, work, marriage visas…). We check the required limits before you sign.

en.intro: Tammy sells KrungThai AXA on the island and stays around when there’s a claim. She compares iHealthy levels (limits, excess, partner hospitals) in plain French.

faq.question: What is iHealthy?
faq.answer: AXA’s local health range in Thailand, several annual limits, sometimes an excess, partner hospitals. Picking a tier depends on your visa and monthly budget.

en.pageH1: Real estate in Phuket and Krabi
en.metaDescription: Buy or rent in Phuket & Krabi with Thomas (Rawai, Chalong, Ao Nang). French-speaking agent.
en.intro: Buying or renting around Rawai, Chalong, Kata or Krabi (Ao Nang)? Thomas has been showing properties for years, visits, offers, leases, handovers.

faq.question: Can foreigners buy here?
faq.answer: Condos often yes (foreign quota). Villas may be leasehold. Thomas tells you what’s realistic, no fairy tales.

faq.question: Popular areas?
faq.answer: Rawai, Nai Harn, Chalong for quiet life; Kata/Patong busier; Krabi for an Andaman base.
